steps.eval: (() => { const doc = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((iframe) => iframe.src.includes('addtorrent.html')).contentDocument; const div = doc.getElementById('addTorrentFilesTableDiv'); const rows = [...div.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')]; if (div.scrollWidth > div.clientWidth) throw new Error(`${div.scrollWidth - div.clientWidth}px wider than the dialog`); if (rows.some((tr) => doc.defaultView.getComputedStyle(tr).display !== 'flex')) throw new Error('not cards'); const cut = rows.map((tr) => tr.querySelector('td[data-column=name] span')).filter((span) => span.scrollWidth > span.clientWidth); if (cut.length > 0) throw new Error(`names cut off: ${cut.map((span) => span.textContent).join(', ')}`); const outside = rows.filter((tr) => tr.querySelector('td[data-column=priority] select').getBoundingClientRect().right > div.getBoundingClientRect().right + 1); if (outside.length > 0) throw new Error(`${outside.length} priority selects outside the card`); return `${rows.length} cards`; })()

(() => { const doc = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((iframe) => iframe.src.includes('addtorrent.html')).contentDocument; const row = (text) => [...doc.querySelectorAll('#addTorrentFilesTableDiv tbody tr')].find((tr) => tr.textContent.includes(text)); const file = row('Behind the scenes').querySelector('input[type=checkbox]'); const folder = row('Extras').querySelector('input[type=checkbox]'); if (file.checked || folder.checked) throw new Error(`file checked: ${file.checked}, folder checked: ${folder.checked}`); return 'unchecked'; })()

(() => { const doc = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((iframe) => iframe.src.includes('addtorrent.html')).contentDocument; const row = (text) => [...doc.querySelectorAll('#addTorrentFilesTableDiv tbody tr')].find((tr) => tr.textContent.includes(text)); const episode = row('Episode 01'); if ((episode !== undefined) && (episode.offsetHeight > 0)) throw new Error('Season 1 did not collapse'); return 'collapsed'; })()

(() => { const doc = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((iframe) => iframe.src.includes('addtorrent.html')).contentDocument; const menu = doc.getElementById('torrentFilesMenu'); if (!menu.classList.contains('visible') && (menu.getBoundingClientRect().top < 0)) throw new Error('no menu'); return [...menu.querySelectorAll('li')].filter((li) => li.offsetHeight > 0).map((li) => li.firstElementChild.textContent.trim()).join(' | '); })()

(() => { const touch = matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches; const frame = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((iframe) => iframe.src.includes('addtorrent.html')); const doc = frame.contentDocument; const selectable = (el) => doc.defaultView.getComputedStyle(el).userSelect !== 'none'; const browserMenu = (el) => { const event = new doc.defaultView.MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); el.dispatchEvent(event); return !event.defaultPrevented; }; const label = doc.querySelector('label[for=savepath]') ?? doc.querySelector('label'); const field = doc.getElementById('savepath') ?? doc.querySelector('input[type=text]'); const result = { labelText: selectable(label), fieldText: selectable(field), infoHashText: selectable(doc.getElementById('infoHashV1')), labelBrowserMenu: browserMenu(label), fieldBrowserMenu: browserMenu(field) }; const expected = { labelText: !touch, fieldText: true, infoHashText: true, labelBrowserMenu: !touch, fieldBrowserMenu: true }; const wrong = Object.keys(expected).filter((key) => result[key] !== expected[key]); if (wrong.length > 0) throw new Error(`unexpected: ${wrong.join(', ')}`); return result; })()

(() => { const doc = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].find((iframe) => iframe.src.includes('addtorrent.html')).contentDocument; const column = doc.querySelector('.column').getBoundingClientRect(); const outside = [...doc.querySelectorAll('.column:first-child :is(fieldset, table, input, select, textarea)')].filter((el) => (el.offsetWidth > 0) && (el.getBoundingClientRect().right > column.right + 0.5)).map((el) => `${el.tagName}#${el.id}`); if (outside.length > 0) throw new Error(`wider than their column: ${outside.join(', ')}`); return `everything fits the ${Math.round(column.width)}px column`; })()
